description_zh: 查询镜像会话的详细信息

name: ListTrafficMirrorSessions

parameters.help_en:
The name of the traffic mirror session.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
镜像会话的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_session_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的最大记录条数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror source. Currently, elastic network interfaces (ENIs) are supported as traffic mirror sources
parameters.help_zh: 镜像源的实例ID，目前支持弹性网卡作为镜像源
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_source_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror destination. Currently, elastic network interfaces (ENIs) and internal-facing SLB instances are supported as traffic mirror destinations. Elastic network interfaces are also referred to as network interface controllers (NICs)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像目的的实例ID，目前支持弹性网卡和私网负载均衡实例作为镜像目的
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_target_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror filter
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像筛选条件的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_id

parameters.help_en: The Virtual Network Identifier (VNI) used to distinguish different mirrored data. Valid values: 0 to 16777215. You can use the VNI to identify mirrored data from different sessions at the traffic mirror destination. You can specify a custom VNI value or let the system randomly assign one. To let the system randomly assign a value, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定VNI，用来区分不同的镜像流量，取值范围为0~16777215。您可以通过VNI在镜像目的区分不同会话的镜像流量。您可以自定义VNI的值，也可以由系统随机分配该值。如果由系统随机分配该值，请不传该参数
parameters.name: virtual_network_id

parameters.help_en:
The priority of traffic mirror session. Valid values: 1 to 32766.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The priority of traffic mirror session created by the same account in the same region must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
镜像会话的优先级，取值范围为1~32766。

数字越小，优先级越高。同一账号在同一个地域创建的镜像会话优先级不能重复
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the traffic mirror session is enabled. Valid values:

false (default): The traffic mirror session is not enabled.

true: The traffic mirror session is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启流量会话，取值：

false（默认值）：不开启流量会话。

true：开启流量会话
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of traffic mirror sessions. The maximum value of N is 100, which means you can query up to 100 traffic mirror sessions
parameters.help_zh: 镜像会话的实例ID。其中N最大取值为100，即支持查询最多100个镜像会话
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_session_ids

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the traffic mirror session. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID. For information about the regions that support traffic mirroring, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.help_zh: 镜像会话的所属地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。关于流量镜像支持的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the traffic mirroring session belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的流量镜像所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

schema.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken has a value, the value is the token for the next query
schema.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken has a value, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

true: The traffic mirror session is enabled
Enabled.description_zh:
是否已开启流量会话，取值：

PacketLength.description_en:
The length of the original packet to be mirrored (excluding the VXLAN packet length). Default value: 1500. Valid values: 64 to 8500. Unit: bytes.
This parameter affects the packet length received by the traffic mirror destination. For more information, see the mirrored packet length and MTU limits in [Traffic mirroring overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html）.

This parameter is available only in specific regions. For more information, see the mirrored packet length parameter description in [Create and manage traffic mirrors]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207514.html）
PacketLength.description_zh:
指定被镜像的原始报文长度（不包含VXLAN报文长度），默认值1500，取值范围：64～8500，单位：字节。
该参数的大小会影响镜像目的收到的报文长度，详情请参见[流量镜像概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html）中的镜像报文长度和MTU限制。

该参数仅在部分地域可用，详情请参见[创建和管理流量镜像]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207514.html）中的镜像报文长度参数描述

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the traffic mirror session.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh:

数字越小，优先级越高
